newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks slip after US industrial production.
newsitem.headline: French stocks slip after US industrial production.

text.p: French shares posted losses after the publication of a higher than expected figure for U.S. March industrial production after having held on to modest gains for most of the day, dealers said.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index was down 10.03 points or 0.38 percent at 2,610.60 at 1328 GMT while the CAC-40 futures contract was down 17 at 2,609.
